# Repository Instructions

## Project Overview

This repository is a minimal learning workspace for GitHub Copilot and Codespaces in VS Code.

## Working Conventions

- Keep changes small and easy to follow.
- Prefer step-by-step explanations when documenting workflows.
- Preserve the existing README content unless the user asks for documentation changes.
- Verify documentation edits by checking the rendered Markdown structure and git diff.

## Validation

There is currently no application build or test suite. For documentation-only changes, inspect the diff and confirm that referenced files and commands are accurate.
